items.title_cn: 基线中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值与重症急性胰腺炎的非线性关联：基于MIMIC-IV数据库
items.title_en: Nonlinear association between baseline neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and severe acute pancreatitis in the MIMIC-IV database

items.title_cn: 随访CT发现的胰腺炎相关假性动脉瘤的急诊血管内治疗
items.title_en: Urgent Endovascular Treatment of a Pancreatitis-Related Pseudoaneurysm Identified on Follow-Up CT
items.abstract_cn: 内脏动脉假性动脉瘤（VA-PSA）是急慢性胰腺炎一种少见但危及生命的并发症，尤其在存在包裹性坏死（WON）的情况下。由于破裂风险高，早期影像学识别至关重要。我们报道一例51岁慢性胰腺炎男性患者，其在胰头坏死性集合内出现起源于肝固有动脉的假性动脉瘤。随访增强计算机断层扫描（CT）显示WON内新出现动脉期强化灶。数字减影血管造影（DSA）证实了假性动脉瘤，并通过经右股动脉途径置入覆膜支架成功将其隔绝。术后恢复顺利，短期随访CT显示病灶持续被隔绝。
items.abstract_en: Visceral artery pseudoaneurysm (VA-PSA) is an uncommon but life-threatening complication of acute-on-chronic pancreatitis, particularly in the presence of walled-off necrosis (WON). Early radiological recognition is essential because of the high risk of rupture. We present the case of a 51-year-old man with chronic pancreatitis who developed a pseudoaneurysm arising from the proper hepatic artery within a pancreatic head necrotic collection. Follow-up contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) demonstrated a new arterial-phase enhancing focus within the WON. Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) confirmed the pseudoaneurysm, which was successfully excluded with a covered stent placed via a right transfemoral approach. Post-procedural recovery was uneventful, and short-term follow-up CT showed persistent exclusion of the lesion.
items.summary_cn: 本文报道一例慢性胰腺炎伴包裹性坏死（WON）患者，随访增强CT发现胰头坏死区内新发动脉期强化灶，经DSA确诊为肝固有动脉假性动脉瘤，并通过右股动脉途径置入覆膜支架成功隔绝，术后恢复顺利且短期随访CT显示病变持续隔绝。

items.title_cn: 血液灌流联合连续静脉-静脉血液滤过治疗高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎的疗效异质性：按炎症反应严重程度分层
items.title_en: Efficacy Heterogeneity of Hemoperfusion Plus Continuous Venovenous Hemofiltration for Hypertriglyceridemia-Induced Acute Pancreatitis Stratified by Severity of Inflammatory Response.
items.abstract_cn: 背景：本研究旨在探讨在高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）患者中，血液灌流（HP）联合连续性静脉-静脉血液滤过（CVVH）与单纯CVVH在降低重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）发生率方面的疗效异质性，并按炎症标志物C反应蛋白（CRP）进行分层。此外，我们评估了次要结局，包括实验室应答、疾病严重程度与器官功能、医疗资源利用及治疗相关指标，以描绘联合治疗更广泛的疗效特征及其与主要终点的关系。进一步地，我们试图确定基于CRP的联合治疗治疗窗。方法：本单中心回顾性研究纳入204例患者，分为HP + CVVH组（n = 103）或CVVH组（n = 101）。采用多因素logistic回归评估两组间的总体疗效差异。采用限制性立方样条（RCS）分析疗效与CRP水平之间的非线性关系，并确定基于CRP的治疗窗。次要结局分析中，分类变量采用多因素logistic回归，定量变量采用广义线性模型。结果：经多因素调整后，HP + CVVH组与CVVH组之间SAP发生率无显著差异（p > 0.05）。RCS分析显示治疗分组与CRP水平之间存在显著交互作用。SAP的条件比值比（HP + CVVH vs. CVVH）仅在特定CRP范围内显著低于1：主分析中为194.96-296.91 mg/L，倾向性评分调整后为200.77-285.81 mg/L（p < 0.05）。在次要结局方面，HP + CVVH与第3天CRP、降钙素原和甘油三酯水平显著降低、14天内无SIRS天数更多、腹腔内压峰值更低、ICU住院时间更短、CVVH次数更少、肠内营养启动更早以及血液净化相关费用更高相关（均p < 0.05）。在无器官衰竭天数、胰腺坏死发生率、住院时间、总住院费用、总吗啡当量剂量、碳青霉烯类药物使用或机械通气持续时间方面，未观察到显著差异（均p > 0.05）。结论：HP + CVVH在预防SAP方面未显示出优于单纯CVVH的总体优势。然而，次要结局分析表明，其在炎症控制改善、全身炎症反应更快消退、腹腔内压降低以及若干资源相关和治疗相关指标的更好恢复方面具有优势，提示可测量的生物学和临床过程获益。然而，这些获益并未转化为SAP的统一降低。HP + CVVH对硬终点的效应是有条件的、非线性的，且依赖于基线炎症负荷，显著获益仅限于特定的CRP治疗窗。因此，次要终点的改善不应等同于硬终点获益，启动HP + CVVH的决策应根据炎症反应强度进行个体化制定。
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: This study aimed to investigate the heterogeneity in the efficacy of hemoperfusion (HP) plus continuous venovenous hemofiltration (CVVH) versus CVVH alone in reducing the incidence of severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) among patients with hypertriglyceridemia-induced acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP), stratified by the inflammatory marker C-reactive protein (CRP). In addition, we assessed secondary outcomes encompassing laboratory response, disease severity and organ function, healthcare resource utilization, and treatment-related indicators, so as to delineate the broader efficacy profile of the combination therapy and its relationship with the primary endpoint. Furthermore, we sought to identify a CRP-based therapeutic window for the combination therapy. METHODS: This single-center retrospective study included 204 patients who were assigned to the HP + CVVH group (n = 103) or the CVVH group (n = 101). Multivariable logistic regression was used to assess the overall difference in efficacy between the two groups. Restricted cubic splines (RCS) were employed to analyze the nonlinear relationship between treatment efficacy and CRP levels and to identify a CRP-based therapeutic window. Secondary outcomes were analyzed using multivariable logistic regression for categorical variables and generalized linear models for quantitative variables. RESULTS: After multivariable adjustment, the incidence of SAP did not differ significantly between the HP + CVVH and CVVH groups (p > 0.05). RCS analysis revealed a significant interaction between treatment group and CRP levels. The conditional odds ratio for SAP (HP + CVVH vs. CVVH) was significantly below 1 only within a specific CRP range: 194.96-296.91 mg/L in the primary analysis and 200.77-285.81 mg/L after propensity score adjustment (p < 0.05). Regarding secondary outcomes, HP + CVVH was associated with significantly lower CRP, procalcitonin, and triglyceride levels on day 3, more SIRS-free days within 14 days, lower peak intra-abdominal pressure, shorter ICU length of stay, fewer CVVH sessions, earlier initiation of enteral nutrition, and higher blood purification-related costs (all p < 0.05). No significant differences were observed in organ failure-free days, incidence of pancreatic necrosis, hospital length of stay, total hospitalization cost, total morphine equivalent dose, carbapenem use, or duration of mechanical ventilation (all p > 0.05). CONCLUSION: HP + CVVH showed no overall superiority to CVVH alone in preventing SAP. Nevertheless, secondary outcome analyses demonstrated improved inflammatory control, faster resolution of systemic inflammatory response, reduced intra-abdominal pressure, and better recovery in several resource-related and treatment-related indicators, indicating measurable biological and clinical process benefits. These benefits, however, did not translate into a uniform reduction in SAP. The effect of HP + CVVH on the hard endpoint was conditional, nonlinear, and dependent on baseline inflammatory burden, with significant benefit confined to a specific CRP therapeutic window. Therefore, improvements in secondary endpoints should not be equated with hard-endpoint benefit, and the decision to initiate HP + CVVH should be individualized according to the intensity of the inflammatory response.

items.title_cn: 脂肪因子作为儿童急性胰腺炎生物标志物的前瞻性探索性单中心观察研究
items.title_en: Adipokines as biomarkers in paediatric acute pancreatitis: a prospective exploratory single-centre observational study
items.abstract_cn: 脂肪因子参与炎症反应，包括急性胰腺炎（AP）的发病机制。成人研究表明其作为AP严重程度和临床病程生物标志物的潜在作用。评估脂联素、抵抗素、内脂素和成纤维细胞生长因子-21（FGF-21）作为儿童AP生物标志物的实用性，涉及疾病严重程度和营养状况。这项前瞻性观察性探索性研究纳入了2020年至2024年间住院的AP患儿以及伴有功能性腹痛的正常体重对照组。比较了组间及根据营养状况和疾病严重程度的脂肪因子浓度。进行了受试者工作特征分析和单因素逻辑回归，以评估脂肪因子和常规炎症标志物的判别性能和关联。研究纳入57例诊断为AP的儿童和33例对照组；18例AP患者超重或肥胖。AP分类为轻度46例，中度重症10例，重症1例。经多重比较校正后，AP患儿与对照组之间以及超重或肥胖AP患者与正常体重AP患者之间的脂肪因子浓度无统计学显著差异。中度至重度AP与72小时后较高的内脂素浓度（0.48 vs 0.28 ng/mL）和较高的常规炎症标志物相关。72小时后的内脂素在识别中度至重度AP方面表现出中等判别性能（AUC = 0.752，95% CI：0.612–0.893；p < 0.001）。在逻辑回归中，仅常规炎症标志物可预测AP严重程度。尽管所选脂肪因子与儿童AP的炎症和代谢改变相关，但均未表现出优于常规炎症标志物的判别性能。所选脂肪因子可能反映儿童急性胰腺炎（AP）的炎症和代谢改变；然而，其作为独立生物标志物的临床实用性似乎有限。72小时后测量的内脂素与中度至重度AP相关，尽管其判别性能劣于常规炎症标志物，且其浓度低于检测方法的检测范围，使这些结果呈半定量性质。在儿童AP中，脂肪因子应被视为常规炎症标志物的补充而非替代生物标志物。所选脂肪因子可能反映儿童急性胰腺炎（AP）的炎症和代谢改变；然而，其作为独立生物标志物的临床实用性似乎有限。72小时后测量的内脂素与中度至重度AP相关，尽管其判别性能劣于常规炎症标志物，且其浓度低于检测方法的检测范围，使这些结果呈半定量性质。在儿童AP中，脂肪因子应被视为常规炎症标志物的补充而非替代生物标志物。
items.abstract_en: Adipokines are involved in inflammatory response, including pathogenesis of acute pancreatitis (AP). Studies in adults suggest their potential role as biomarkers of AP severity and clinical course. To evaluate the utility of adiponectin, resistin, visfatin, and fibroblast growth factor-21 (FGF-21) as biomarkers in paediatric AP, with regard to disease severity and nutritional status. This prospective observational exploratory study included children with AP hospitalised between 2020 and 2024 and normal-weight controls with functional abdominal pain. Adipokine concentrations were compared between groups and according to nutritional status, and disease severity. Receiver operating characteristic analysis and univariate logistic regression were performed to evaluate the discriminatory performance and associations of adipokines and conventional inflammatory markers. The study included 57 children diagnosed with AP and 33 controls; 18 patients with AP were overweight or obese. AP was classified as mild in 46 patients, moderately severe in 10, and severe in 1 child. No statistically significant differences in adipokine concentrations between children with AP and controls, as well as between AP patients with overweight or obesity and normal body weight remained after correction for multiple comparisons. Moderate-to-severe AP was associated with higher visfatin concentration after 72 h (0.48 vs 0.28 ng/mL) and higher conventional inflammatory markers. Visfatin after 72 h demonstrated moderate discriminatory performance for identifying moderate-to-severe AP (AUC = 0.752, 95% CI: 0.612–0.893; p < 0.001). In logistic regression, only conventional inflammatory markers predicted AP severity. Although selected adipokines were associated with inflammatory and metabolic alterations in paediatric AP, none demonstrated superior discriminatory performance compared with conventional inflammatory markers. Selected adipokines may reflect inflammatory and metabolic alterations in paediatric acute pancreatitis (AP); however, their clinical utility as standalone biomarkers appears limited.Visfatin measured after 72 hours was associated with moderate-to-severe AP, although its discriminatory performance was inferior to that of conventional inflammatory markers, and its concentrations fell below the assay’s detection range, making these results semi-quantitative.Adipokines should be considered complementary rather than alternative biomarkers to conventional inflammatory markers in paediatric AP. Visfatin measured after 72 hours was associated with moderate-to-severe AP, although its discriminatory performance was inferior to that of conventional inflammatory markers, and its concentrations fell below the assay’s detection range, making these results semi-quantitative. items.summary_cn: 在儿童急性胰腺炎中，脂肪因子（脂联素、抵抗素、内脂素、FGF-21）与对照组及不同营养状态间无显著差异；仅72小时内脂素与中重度AP相关（AUC=0.752），但判别性能不及常规炎症标志物，且浓度低于检测下限使结果呈半定量。脂肪因子应被视为常规炎症标志物的补充而非替代生物标志物。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎患者血清白脂素浓度与病情严重程度：一项连续测量的前瞻性病例对照研究
items.title_en: Serum Asprosin Concentrations and Severity in Acute Pancreatitis: A Prospective Case–Control Study with Serial Measurements
items.abstract_cn: 背景/目的：白脂素（Asprosin）是一种禁食诱导的升糖脂肪因子，在实验模型中具有促炎作用，但其在急性胰腺炎（AP）中的表现尚不清楚。在这项探索性研究中，我们检验了AP患者与健康对照者之间循环白脂素是否存在差异、其在住院期间如何变化以及是否与疾病严重程度相关。方法：在这项前瞻性病例对照研究中，纳入了82例AP患者（从183例筛选者中排除糖尿病、高甘油三酯血症和病态肥胖后）和82例性别匹配的健康对照者。采用ELISA法测定患者入院时、72小时和120小时的血清白脂素水平，对照者于空腹状态测定一次。严重程度依据修订版Atlanta分类定义。由于患者年龄和体重均大于对照者，组间差异经年龄、体质指数和性别校正，并在事后匹配子样本中进行分析。结果：入院时白脂素水平患者为4.52（2.94–5.89）ng/mL，对照者为3.55（2.24–4.92）ng/mL（p = 0.071）；经年龄、体质指数和性别校正后的几何均值比为1.17（95% CI 0.85–1.61）。在事后年龄和性别匹配对中，患者白脂素较高（中位差值1.91 ng/mL，95% CI 0.24–3.78），但在体质指数和性别匹配对中无显著差异（0.96 ng/mL，−0.34至2.72）。白脂素在五天内变化不大，且与中度重症或重症AP无关联（AUC 0.57，95%置信上限≤0.71）；仅7例患者为重症AP。结论：在这项探索性研究中，AP患者血清白脂素水平较对照者轻度升高但无统计学显著性，未检测到与严重程度之间具有统计学意义的关联。年龄和体质指数的残余混杂、排除糖尿病或高甘油三酯血症（≥200 mg/dL）患者以及缺乏内部检测验证，均使本研究无法得出确切结论。这些数据为开展样本量充足的AP白脂素匹配研究提供了效应量估计。
items.abstract_en: Background/Objectives: Asprosin is a fasting-induced glucogenic adipokine with pro-inflammatory effects in experimental models, but its behaviour in acute pancreatitis (AP) is unknown. In this exploratory study, we examined whether circulating asprosin differs between patients with AP and healthy controls, how it changes during hospitalisation and whether it is associated with disease severity. Methods: In this prospective case–control study, 82 patients with AP (of 183 screened, after exclusion of diabetes, hypertriglyceridaemia and morbid obesity) and 82 sex-matched healthy controls were enrolled. Serum asprosin was measured by ELISA at admission, 72 h and 120 h in patients and once in fasting controls. Severity was defined by the revised Atlanta classification. Because patients were older and heavier than controls, the group difference was adjusted for age, body mass index and sex and examined in post hoc matched subsamples. Results: Admission asprosin was 4.52 (2.94–5.89) ng/mL in patients and 3.55 (2.24–4.92) ng/mL in controls (p = 0.071); the ratio of geometric means adjusted for age, body mass index and sex was 1.17 (95% CI 0.85–1.61). Asprosin was higher in patients in post hoc age- and sex-matched pairs (median difference 1.91 ng/mL, 95% CI 0.24–3.78) but not in body mass index- and sex-matched pairs (0.96 ng/mL, −0.34 to 2.72). Asprosin changed little over five days and was not associated with moderately severe or severe AP (AUC 0.57, upper 95% confidence limits ≤0.71); only seven patients had severe AP. Conclusions: In this exploratory study, serum asprosin was modestly and non-significantly higher in patients with AP than in controls, and no statistically significant association with severity was detected. Residual confounding by age and body mass index, the exclusion of patients with diabetes or hypertriglyceridaemia (≥200 mg/dL) and the absence of in-house assay validation preclude firm conclusions. These data provide effect estimates for adequately powered, matched studies of asprosin in AP.
items.summary_cn: 在这项探索性病例对照研究中，急性胰腺炎患者入院时血清asprosin中位数4.52 ng/mL，高于健康对照的3.55 ng/mL，但差异未达统计学显著（p=0.071），校正年龄、BMI和性别后几何均值比为1.17（95% CI 0.85–1.61）。asprosin在住院5天内变化很小，且与中度重症或重症急性胰腺炎无显著关联（AUC 0.57，95% CI上限≤0.71）。

items.title_cn: 甘油三酯与动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病及急性胰腺炎风险：4个基于人群的队列
items.title_en: Triglycerides and Risk of Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and Acute Pancreatitis: 4 Population-Based Cohorts

items.title_cn: 商陆皂苷A缓解急性胰腺炎肠动力障碍，可能涉及肠神经元NF-κB/nNOS通路
items.title_en: Esculentoside A alleviates intestinal dysmotility in acute pancreatitis with potential involvement of the NF-κB/nNOS pathway in enteric neurons
items.abstract_cn: 背景 商陆皂苷甲（EsA）是一种来源于商陆根的三萜皂苷，具有抗炎、抗肿瘤等多种药理作用。然而，其在急性胰腺炎（AP）相关肠道动力障碍中的作用尚未被探索。AP中肠道动力障碍的机制尚不清楚，其中肠神经元（ENs）发挥主要作用。本研究旨在探讨AP中肠道动力障碍的机制，并探索EsA干预的治疗潜力。方法 建立AP大鼠在体模型，同时采用共培养ENs与肠道平滑肌细胞（ISMCs）建立体外AP模型，随后进行EsA干预。通过蛋白质组学筛选差异蛋白并进行生物信息学分析。通过检测结肠平滑肌条收缩活动、粪便颗粒计数以及ISMCs的收缩活性和迁移能力来评估肠道动力。测定一氧化氮（NO）水平。采用免疫荧光和免疫组化检测nNOS阳性神经元数量、nNOS表达及NF-κB p65核转位。采用Western blotting检测PI3K/Akt/NF-κB/nNOS信号通路相关分子的蛋白水平。结果 LC-MS/MS蛋白质组学分析显示，AP大鼠肌层中NF-κB和PI3K/Akt通路显著富集。AP期间的在体和体外实验均证实PI3K/Akt/NF-κB/nNOS通路被激活，表现为p-PI3K、p-Akt、p-IKKβ、p-NF-κB p65和p-IκBα水平升高，IκBα降解增加，NF-κB p65核转位增强，nNOS表达及nNOS阳性神经元数量上调，从而促进NO产生。这抑制了ISMCs的收缩活性和迁移能力，最终导致大鼠粪便颗粒计数减少及结肠肌条收缩活动降低。EsA干预有助于下调ENs中NF-κB p65的核转位、nNOS表达及NO水平，从而改善ISMC功能。结论 PI3K/Akt/NF-κB/nNOS通路的异常激活可能参与AP肠道动力障碍的发病机制。EsA可能通过抑制NF-κB/nNOS轴减少NO产生，从而改善AP相关肠道动力障碍。
items.abstract_en: Background Esculentoside A (EsA), a triterpenoid saponin from Phytolacca esculenta roots, exerts anti-inflammatory, antitumor, and other pharmacological effects. However, its role in AP-related intestinal motility disorders rema1ins unexplored. The mechanism underlying intestinal dysmotility in acute pancreatitis (AP) remains unclear, with enteric neurons (ENs) playing a primary role. This study aimed to investigate the mechanism of intestinal dysmotility in AP and explore the therapeutic potential of EsA intervention. Methods An in vivo rat model of AP was established, together with in vitro AP models using co-cultured ENs and intestinal smooth muscle cells (ISMCs), followed by EsA intervention. Differential proteins were screened via proteomics and subjected to bioinformatic analysis. Intestinal motility was evaluated by detecting the contractile activity of colonic smooth muscle strips, fecal pellet counts, as well as the contractile activity and migratory capacity of ISMCs. Nitric oxide (NO) levels were measured. Immunofluorescence and immunohistochemistry were used to determine the number of nNOS-positive neurons, nNOS expression, and NF-κB p65 nuclear translocation. Western blotting was performed to detect the protein levels of PI3K/Akt/NF-κB/nNOS signaling-related molecules. Results LC-MS/MS proteomic analysis revealed significant enrichment of NF-κB and PI3K/Akt pathways in the muscularis of AP rats. Both in vivo and in vitro experiments during AP demonstrated activation of the PI3K/Akt/NF-κB/nNOS pathways, manifested by elevated p-PI3K, p-Akt, p-IKKβ, p-NF-κB p65, and p-IκBα levels, increased IκBα degradation, enhanced NF-κB p65 nuclear translocation, and upregulation of nNOS expression and nNOS-positive neuronal counts, thereby promoting NO production. This inhibited the contractile activity and migratory capacity of ISMCs, ultimately reducing rat fecal pellet counts in rats and decreasing the contractile activity of colonic muscle strips. EsA intervention contributed to downregulating the nuclear translocation of NF-κB p65, nNOS expression, and NO levels in ENs, thereby improving ISMC function. Conclusion Aberrant activation of the PI3K/Akt/NF-κB/nNOS pathway may contribute to the pathogenesis of intestinal dysmotility in AP. EsA may reduce NO production, presumably by suppressing the NF-κB/nNOS axis, thereby ameliorating AP-associated intestinal dysmotility.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现急性胰腺炎中肠神经元PI3K/Akt/NF-κB/nNOS通路异常激活，导致NO产生增加，抑制肠道平滑肌细胞收缩和迁移能力，从而引起肠道动力障碍；EsA可通过抑制NF-κB p65核转位和nNOS表达、降低NO水平来改善这一动力障碍。

items.title_cn: 更正：针对复发性急性和慢性胰腺炎患者疼痛管理的数字化认知行为疗法（IMPACT-2）：混合有效性-实施试验研究方案
items.title_en: Correction: Digital cognitive-behavioral therapy for pain management in individuals with recurrent acute and chronic pancreatitis (IMPACT-2): study protocol for a hybrid effectiveness-implementation trial
items.summary_cn: 该论文为IMPACT-2研究方案的更正，介绍针对复发性急性及慢性胰腺炎患者疼痛管理的数字化认知行为疗法（digital cognitive-behavioral therapy），采用混合效果-实施试验设计。摘要内容缺失，仅从标题可见其聚焦胰腺炎患者的心理行为干预，与消化内科临床及内镜方向属相邻领域。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
